mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1.5% signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS < 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 245.0 indicates accelerating inflation, which triggers central bank tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 245.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in employment growth signals deteriorating labor market conditions, depressing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery regime, housing starts above 1300 units signal strengthening consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods with HOUST > 1300 during post-recession recovery.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 105.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods with INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales below 492904 million dollars signals weakening consumer spending, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods with RSAFS < 492904.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 2.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales signals broad economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when HOUST falls and RSAFS falls.
